\begin{aligned}
a(0) &= 1 \\
a(1) &= 5 \\
a(2) &= 11 \\
a(n) &= \min(5 \cdot a(i), 11 \cdot a(j)) \quad \text{for } i, j < n
\end{aligned}
}
$$

This recursive formula generates the sequence of numbers of the form $ 5^a \times 11^b $, sorted in increasing order.
